text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow is finally the Satsuki Sho.
However, the weather forecast didn't look promising."
choice_data_list: They say there's gonna be a storm tomorrow……

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It appears so.
But don't worry! We've prepared measures for heavy track conditions!

Satono Diamond gives a reassuring reply.
Just to be safe, I decided we should leave
Tracen Academy early tomorrow.

The next morning—the rain wasn't too heavy.
However, a fierce wind blew relentlessly.

It looked like the strong winds would suspend train services.
Thinking ahead, I decided to take a taxi to Nakayama Racecourse.
However, severe traffic backed up on the highway due to the bad weather. Even past our scheduled arrival time, we still couldn't get off the highway—

Even after taking local roads, the traffic jam continued.
At this rate, we're going to be late...!
choice_data_list: We have no choice but to get out of the car and run to the racetrack!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll head on ahead!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ugh...! Such strong wind...!

A wind so fierce it almost knocked Satono Diamond off her feet.
A spring storm, unusual for this time of year. To think it would get us stuck in traffic and nearly make us late—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(A rare storm... traffic jams...
Why did everything have to go wrong today of all days...?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (...Could it be...... a jinx?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(At this rate, even running is in jeopardy...
And this agitation will disrupt my running...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Is this jinx trying to block my path
to becoming a "legendary Umamusume"...?!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (...! In that case, I can't afford to lose!!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: *Gaaaasp*!

No sooner had she shouted than Satono Diamond sprinted
down the Umamusume-only lane at breakneck speed.
I arrived at Nakayama Racecourse thirty minutes before the scheduled post time for the Satsuki Sho.

Please let me make it in time—
I head towards the paddock, praying under my breath.
Satono Diamond was nowhere to be seen...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, made it just in the nick of time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My pace got thrown off a little, but...
it actually helped me calm down instead!

Satono Diamond smiled brightly.
Time and again, her mental fortitude never ceases to amaze.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The first leg of the Classic Triple Crown...
I definitely cannot afford to lose!!

As if answering her determination,
the rain clouds cleared away before we knew it, and dazzling sunlight poured down.
